15.t: Working with data: isomers of pentane
q: Which isomer has the highest boiling point?
Explain why these three are isomers.
Same molecular formula (C₅H₁₂) but a different arrangement of atoms.
Describe the effect of branching on boiling point.
Explain this effect using the shape of the molecules.
Branched molecules are more compact, so they have less contact with each other: weaker forces between molecules, less energy needed to boil.
